SQL Server Note
fields.options:
RFID SQL Agent — SQL Server Source

Polls a Microsoft SQL Server table where RFID/biometric terminals log swipes, and pulls new rows in order, tracking the last row imported so nothing is missed or duplicated.

fields.options: The poller only fetches rows with id > Last Log ID and advances this value on every successful run. If the source table has a long history, use the date range below to skip straight to a specific period instead of importing everything from the start.
